attacks_n198.interpretation: Detection improvement is statistically significant: 10 attacks newly caught vs only 1 newly missed.

benign_n198.interpretation: FPR increase is real (1->7 false alarms) but just short of significance at n=198 (p=0.070).

mcnemar_subgroups.note: The overall (mixed) McNemar above is not significant because it nets two opposite, individually-diagnosable effects: a significant detection gain and a near-significant FPR cost. Reporting them separately, not just the net, is the honest picture.
